howItWorks.title:
Four steps.

No commute.
howItWorks.subtitle: From booking to the written plan, everything happens in one place — at your own pace.

booking.title: Booking
booking.description: Choose a slot from the calendar and fill in a short form with the reason for your visit.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: 24h before, you receive instructions and a list of useful information (tests, food diary, etc.).

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: We meet on video. Duration varies between 50–90 min depending on the type of consultation.

plan.title: Written plan
plan.description: Within 24h you receive a document with recommendations, meal plan (if applicable) and next steps.

howItWorks.footerNote: The video platform, the form and the written plan — all managed in a single portal.

services.title:
How we work

together.
services.headerSub: Five ways to collaborate — from a one-off question to a three-month follow-up. Choose the pace that fits you.

pediatric.title: Pediatric consultation
pediatric.description: Full clinical evaluation on video, detailed history, written recommendations delivered within 24h. For children from birth to adolescence — growth, development, prevention, day-to-day questions.

nutrition.title: Nutrition consultation
nutrition.description: Personalized meal plan for children or adults. History, analysis of existing habits, recent lab work, realistic goals. Includes a scheduled follow-up at 4 weeks.

integrative.title: Integrative consultation & monitoring
integrative.description: Pediatrics and nutrition in a single meeting — for complex cases or the start of a long-term follow-up. Written plan, structured recommendations, first follow-up appointment included.

subscription.title: 3-month monitoring
subscription.description: Three months of active follow-up: direct messaging for questions between consultations, periodic plan adjustments, two monthly video calls. Recommended for long-term goals.

quick.title: Express question
quick.description: For specific questions that don't require a full consultation. You send the question + context through a form and receive a written, documented answer within ~1 hour during working hours.

about.title:
Two specializations,

a single goal
about.body: I am a pediatrician and a nutritionist. The two roles complement each other naturally: I understand a child's body in motion, but also what builds it at the table. I work exclusively online, so that distance is no longer a problem — families from across the country and the diaspora.
